items.summary:
I drove Tesla for the first time; I felt happy like a child for the first 10 minutes, and was totally disappointed the rest of the ride

The autopilot feature is not available in the EU, but even the lane-control works extremely badly

Tesla didn't recognize road works and almost crushed me into a barrier

Then it went completely crazy on a temporary orange lane and started wiggling around

The assistant consistently missed lanes and ignored speed limit signs, so I had to disable the assistant and drive manually

I drove an electric BMW i4 before, and it had a much better cruise control and assistant (it boggles my mind that BMW kicked Tesla's ass in software)

With BMW, I never had to touch the gas pedal and drove the car just using cruise control and speed limit assistant

You could also set a speed limit, and even if you pressed full gas, it never crossed, which was handy in a city

Tesla is still an insane product, the interior and exterior design are amazing, but it feels like an app with an amazing frontend and a very poor backend (at least in the EU)

Driving gave me a lot of motivation to make more $$$, and I will still probably get a Tesla, and not a BMW bz BMW is a car for boomers

items.title: Emerging Risks to Watch: AI, Data Centers, and Autonomous Vehicles - Insurance Journal
items.summary: # Emerging Risks to Watch: AI, Data Centers, and Autonomous Vehicles. We examine how the expanding use of AI is reshaping the risk landscape for insurance–not only within the industry but across the broader economy and physical world. From cybersecurity and data privacy concerns to the infrastructure required to support AI, to its growing role in autonomous systems, understanding where AI-related risks may emerge is essential to managing them effectively. The wide-ranging–and growing–list of AI capabilities and applications makes it difficult to determine how the transformative technology may impact potential losses across specific insurance lines of business. A recently reported security incident involving data access from a popular enterprise generative AI tool highlights how the mass adoption of large language models (LLMs) and the concentration of the office software market may increase the potential for systemic liability exposure across cyber and professional and management liability lines.

Speakers shared examples ranging from media-mix modelling that reduced data preparation time from months to hours to AI-assisted campaign workflows that remove repetitive tasks and allow teams to focus on higher-level planning and creativity. For marketers, agentic AI is increasingly positioned as a productivity layer that frees teams to spend more time on strategy, taste and creative judgment rather than manual execution. 3. **AI-assisted Creative Collaboration** — Tools that blend generative models with human oversight to iterate on strategy, tone and creative assets present opportunities to reshape agency-client workflows and redefine creative production timelines.

items.title: Agentic AI: Navigating The Evolving Frontier - Forbes
items.summary: # Agentic AI: Navigating The Evolving Frontier. As 2026 advances, the digital landscape has evolved to be increasingly proactive and “always-on.” Using technology to guide decisions is leading to the delegation of authority. AI systems that function with machine agency are referred to as "agentic AI." These systems can read intent, plan multi-step activities, use tools, access systems, and carry out tasks independently with little assistance from humans. The age of Agentic AI is transformative rather than incremental. Agentic AI is distinct from passive automation. This moment is characterized by operational autonomy and technical innovation. Agentic AI is increasingly establishing itself as the standard decision-making framework in critical systems. The implication is profound: algorithmic velocity is evolving into a form of national power. Agentic AI expedites the move to autonomous risk. Organizations must transition from reactive cybersecurity to "Security by Design" to mitigate these assaults. In terms of national security, AI autonomy will provide countries with considerable benefits in defense, intelligence, and cybersecurity.

Claims teams use AI-assisted tools to sort incoming materials, summarize large files and support litigation strategy, while defense counsel uses GenAI to draft outlines, organize chronologies and prepare initial drafts. items.summary: # Florida sues OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, accusing them of putting profit over safety. Florida seeks to hold Sam Altman personally liable, accusing OpenAI of marketing ChatGPT as safe while concealing that it could drive users toward harm. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier sued OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman on Monday, accusing the company of putting profit over safety, fueling violence and pushing a product it knew could harm users. “The rise of OpenAI is attributable to a web of deceit and the exploitation of users (including Floridians), leveraging their data and safety to boost OpenAI’s market value at unacceptable costs,” the complaint reviewed by NBC News and filed Monday said. Florida is the first state to sue OpenAI and Altman over design and safety. “Last year’s mass shooting at Florida State University was a tragedy, but ChatGPT is not responsible for this terrible crime,” OpenAI spokesman Drew Pusateri said in a statement to NBC News after the company was sued by the family of a victim of the shooting.

items.title: OpenAI Launches Rosalind Biodefense, Offers Free AI Model to Governments for Pandemic Preparedness - MLQ.ai
items.summary: # OpenAI Launches Rosalind Biodefense, Offers Free AI Model to Governments for Pandemic Preparedness. * OpenAI launched Rosalind Biodefense, a two-track program giving vetted developers and U.S. government agencies free access to GPT-Rosalind for pandemic preparedness and biosecurity work [1]. * GPT-Rosalind outperforms GPT-5, GPT-5.2, and GPT-5.4 on internal benchmarks in chemistry, biochemistry, and experiment design [2]. OpenAI on May 29 launched Rosalind Biodefense, a program that provides free access to its specialized life sciences AI model, GPT-Rosalind, for government agencies, academic institutions, and nonprofit developers working on pandemic preparedness and biodefense [1]. The program operates on two tracks: a developer track sponsoring vetted teams building epidemiological models, early-detection tools, and screening systems, and a government track extending access to select U.S. federal agencies and allied partners for outbreak-response planning, diagnostics, and medical countermeasure development [3]. The Rosalind Biodefense program expands GPT-Rosalind's use from general life-science research into national security and public health applications, marking the first time OpenAI has offered a specialized model free of charge to government partners at this scale [3].

Để gửi email tự động bằng PHP, bạn có thể sử dụng hàm `mail()` có sẵn trong PHP. Dưới đây là một số ý tưởng cho việc gửi email tự động:

1. **Thông báo sự kiện**: Gửi email thông báo cho người dùng về các sự kiện sắp diễn ra, như hội thảo, buổi họp, hoặc các chương trình khuyến mãi.

2. **Nhắc nhở**: Tạo một hệ thống nhắc nhở tự động cho các cuộc hẹn, thanh toán hóa đơn, hoặc các nhiệm vụ cần hoàn thành.

3. **Xác nhận đăng ký**: Gửi email xác nhận cho người dùng sau khi họ đăng ký tài khoản hoặc đăng ký tham gia một sự kiện.

4. **Báo cáo định kỳ**: Tự động gửi báo cáo hàng tuần hoặc hàng tháng cho người quản lý hoặc khách hàng về tình hình hoạt động.

5. **Chào mừng người dùng mới**: Gửi email chào mừng đến người dùng mới khi họ đăng ký, kèm theo thông tin hữu ích hoặc hướng dẫn sử dụng dịch vụ.

6. **Cập nhật sản phẩm**: Gửi thông báo cho khách hàng về các sản phẩm mới, giảm giá, hoặc các chương trình khuyến mãi đặc biệt.

Bạn có thể kết hợp các ý tưởng này với các thư viện như PHPMailer hoặc SwiftMailer để có thêm tính năng và dễ dàng hơn trong việc gửi email.

items.title: arXiv paper 2301.00001
items.summary:
NFTrig: Using Blockchain Technologies for Math Education
JORDAN THOMPSON, Augustana College, USA
RYAN BENAC, Augustana College, USA
KIDUS OLANA, Augustana College, USA
TALHA HASSAN, Augustana College, USA
ANDREW SW ARD,Augustana College, USA
TAUHEED KHAN MOHD, Augustana College, USA
NFTrig is a web-based application created for use as an educational tool to teach trigonometry and block
chain technology. Creation of the application includes front and back end development as well as integration
with other outside sources including MetaMask and OpenSea. The primary development languages include
HTML, CSS (Bootstrap 5), and JavaScript as well as Solidity for smart contract creation. The application itself
is hosted on Moralis utilizing their Web3 API. This technical report describes how the application was created,
what the application requires, and smart contract design with security considerations in mind. The NFTrig
application has underwent significant testing and validation prior to and after deployment. Future suggestions
and recommendations for further development, maintenance, and use in other fields for education are also
described.
CCS Concepts: • Computer systems organization → Redundancy; Robotics; • Networks → Network
reliability.
Additional Key Words and Phrases: Matic, Metamask, polygon, bootstrap5, Solidity
1 INTRODUCTION
The purpose of this report is to describe the technical details involved in the development of the
NFTrig application. This includes both the front end website design, the back end smart contract,
and NFT creation. It will mainly focus on the technical details of the project outlining software
requirements, design through programming languages, client and server side interactions, and
validation testing. This allows the reader to undertake further development, fixes, or maintenance
of the software, as this forms part of the documentation for the software.
The NFTrig project is based around the creation of a web-based game application that allows
interaction of NFTs (non-fungible token) with trigonometric function designs. NFts are digital
assets, for example a picture, that has a unique identification and can generally be freely traded
with cryptocurrency [33]. Through this application, users are able to purchase digital artwork of
many different trigonometric functions and combine them using mathematical operations. Current
supported operations include multiplication and division of the trigonometry functions, and the
output of each operation is a new NFT card that would be the result of an operation. The old cards
will then be removed from the user’s possession and burned using the smart contact. For example,
if a user combined the two cards Sin(x) and Cos(x) using multiplication, they would lose their two
old cards and receive the new card Tan(x). Further, the NFT cards are assigned one of the following
rarity levels: common, uncommon, rare, and legendary. The probability of each of these levels is
defined later in this report.
